{{Top|leg|canon=Percussion Cannon}}
A '''percussion cannon''' was a weapon that was common during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It fired explosive projectiles.

The [[Exocron Airfleet]] made extensive use of these weapons, mounting them on their [[skyfighter]]s. Larger versions, called [[percussion repeater cannon]]s, were used onboard their Airfleet vessels.

By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the weapon was considered to be archaic.
